display_duration.description: Seconds on the panel per appearance; each appearance shows the next scene

style.description: cycle = a different scene each time the clock comes round; or pin one scene

scenes.description: Scenes to cycle through (default all five)

show_seconds.description: Show the seconds as light: a thread, a rising tide, a comet, a sweeping hand

show_temperature.description: Outdoor temperature from the Home Assistant weather entity (needs ha_url and ha_token)

fade_seconds.description: Each appearance fades up from black over this long

timezone.description: e.g. America/New_York. Default: Home Assistant's, then the Pi's own

latitude.description: Where you are, for the Daylight scene (default: Home Assistant's)

test_mode.description: Run time much faster and step through every scene so you can see a whole day. Turn off afterwards.

demo_speed.description: test_mode: clock seconds per real second
